subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Magnitsky Act Story
description: A fast breakdown of The Magnitsky Act Story for builders.

hook.text: A Russian tax lawyer uncovered a $230 million fraud. He was arrested, tortured, and died in prison.

buildup.text: Sergei Magnitsky exposed how Russian officials stole tax refunds through shell companies.

discovery.text: Bill Browder, Magnitsky's client, campaigned for a US law to sanction the officials responsible.

twist.text: The Magnitsky Act freezes assets and bans visas for human rights abusers — a new weapon against corruption.

climax.text: Over 30 countries have adopted Magnitsky-style laws. One man's death created a global accountability tool.

punchline.text: He exposed the fraud. They killed him. The world made a law.

quiz.question: What does the Magnitsky Act do?
options: Sanctions human rights abusers by freezing assets and banning visas
Creates tax breaks for Russian businesses
